supply.source: CHAIN conditional source study, 2026-11-12; tools/chain/supply-study.mjs; hashes in docs/chain/supply-study.json; not C2 telemetry

assumptions.cohort: 1000 pre-enrolled accounts; one 20-YARN tester grant each; no growth or attrition
assumptions.demo: One Star Thread and three free Relics after fixed boss/pass, no routine reward or future sinks
assumptions.implementedSinks: Counterfactual recurring C2 supply/routine issuer; only existing seal and YARN sale burns
assumptions.roadmap: Counterfactual plus unshipped forge and cosmetic sinks; not acceptance evidence
assumptions.demand: 90% weekly activity; persistent adopting wallets (not repeated chances for nonadopters); 20% trade chance*demand; price20 YARN; non-bot buyers only, collection target4; sealers stop at6 owned/unsold items (behavioral assumption, not protocol cap). Source stock carried,240 eligible shelf slots, bound shelf occupancy omitted.
assumptions.policy: SeasonRewards integer arithmetic; all claims incl tester grants; hypothetical issuer signs min(entitlement, remaining cap). Contract rejects oversized claims.
assumptions.rewardSensitivity: 63 additional fixed-seed runs scale 6-YARN boss and 0/1/2/4/6 closed-season rank. Contract caps/20-YARN grants/fees unchanged. No calibrated setting.
assumptions.rewards: Weekly boss completion conditioned on active week:50/90/95/95% casual/regular/farmer/bot; 6 YARN. Rank top1/10/25/50% earns6/4/2/1 once per13-week season. Independent uniform weekly rank-score samples; no paid power. Rank claim from prior season paid in current season, priority within12 cap; remainder expires at next close. Fourth rank pending at week52, not silently excluded.
assumptions.unlocks: Maximum hypothetical external unlocks, not deployed vesting or observed circulation
assumptions.funding: Allocation envelope, not the live 9960-YARN reward pool; demo cohort alone needs 20000 YARN
assumptions.scarcity: 21 seals/week is only an optimistic aggregation of3/day, not a demonstrated daily-feasible path. Source rarity is not scarcity. Stock limits and overflow tracked; no stock valuation.
assumptions.roadmapFeatures: Forge3+2 items max4/season; rename2 max1; decor4 max2; pass12 max1. Demand draws hypothetical, feature-specific burn columns. Item sink would require audited irrecoverable custody, not NFT totalSupply burn.
assumptions.adversary: Bots are wallets, not verified humans; correlated wallet ownership is unmeasured
